plan_name: Sample isolated test failover - three-tier service
stop_conditions: Any unexpected route from the test network to production is detected.
A duplicate identity or production write path is discovered.
The recovered data point is outside the approved RPO or fails integrity checks.
Production health degrades or the agreed change window is exceeded.

steps.name: Confirm change, scope, owners and recovery point
Verify isolated network and blocked production routes
Recover and validate test identity, DNS and time dependencies
Validate firewall policy, certificates and platform services
Recover database and validate consistency/read-only boundary
Start application services in dependency order
Run approved synthetic transactions and business checks
Capture results and clean up test-only resources
